runtime.requestLimit: import preview/commit/replay and export json reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.jobListLimit: admin import/export job lists clamp request limit by maxJobRows
runtime.jobStats: admin import-export.stats returns import/export totals and status aggregates for operational visibility
runtime.jobStatsUi: ability page renders import/export totals and status aggregates as tables, while retaining raw JSON for diagnostics
runtime.failureSamples: admin import-export.stats returns bounded recent importFailureSamples rows so admins can locate failed import jobs without replaying them
runtime.jobStatusFilter: admin import/export job lists accept optional status filter with bound SQL and maxJobRows limit
runtime.importResultStatus: import commit counts success only after row validation, write and derived sync all complete; saved import job status is imported, partial_failed or failed based on final row results
runtime.exportResultUi: ability page renders JSON export as paging/job/field-plan summary and preview rows while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.importResultUi: ability page renders import preview/commit as job summary and per-row result tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.chunkResultUi: ability page renders chunked import preview/commit as chunk summary tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
runtime.replayLimit: import replay output clamps failed rows by maxBatchRows
runtime.categoryBindIntegration: export json rows prefer content_category_bind when content.category is enabled and only use legacy category_id as compatibility fallback
runtime.categoryBindImportSync: import commit synchronizes content_category_bind when content.category is enabled before revision, derived sync and audit side effects
runtime.fieldPlan: export json and field-plan API return availableFields, requestedFields, exportedFields, and ignoredFields without silently accepting unknown field names
runtime.fieldPlanUi: ability page renders import-export.field-plan as field count and exported/ignored/available field tables while retaining raw JSON diagnostics
